unique_value: automated traffic carries explicit purpose and bounded authority rather than implicit trust
strict intent IDs are immutable and successful request nonces cannot consume budget twice
delegated child authority can only attenuate purpose, rate, request budget, and validity window
aggregate child allocations and parent traffic share one finite hierarchical budget
request decisions bind intent fingerprint, request identity, verdict, and post-decision budget state

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning Cloudflare-specialist implementation; extraction preserves identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Authenticate intent issuers and move nonce/budget state into durable distributed storage so replay and hierarchy invariants survive process restarts and concurrent edge workers.
nonclaims: not a production Cloudflare traffic-control service
intent issuer authenticity is not cryptographically verified
nonce and budget state are process-local rather than durable distributed state
